name: io.github.chrischall/simplepractice-mcp
description: SimplePractice Client Portal — appointments, billing, documents, announcements

environmentVariables.name: SIMPLEPRACTICE_PRACTICE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Pins the server to one practice — the slug ("achievebalancetherapy") or the full host. Unset, the practice comes from your emailed sign-in link.

environmentVariables.name: SIMPLEPRACTICE_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where to persist the signed-in session (default ~/.simplepractice-mcp/session.json, written 0600).
